title: The national ANC cascade

title: Regional cascade decomposition
caption: Regions with similar ANC8+ coverage lose women at opposite points.

title: Continuation from 4 to 8 by circumstance
caption: All women shown have already attended four times, so this isolates the cost of repeat attendance from initial demand.

title: Development vs held-out AP
caption: Mean development-to-held-out drop +0.076 AP -- the signature of selection over the same folds, not of a better model.

title: Held-out calibration
caption: Weighted decile means; the diagonal is perfect calibration.

title: Repeated-split stability
caption: Mean AP gain +0.0306 [+0.0179, +0.0434] over 20 independent splits.

title: Paired stratified-PSU bootstrap
caption: MLP (full pool) vs XGBoost (21 predictors); the AP interval includes zero, which is why the repeated-split evidence carries the claim.

title: Global predictor importance
caption: Exact additive attribution from the Explainable Boosting model; arrows give the direction of the dominant effect.

title: Fitted shape functions
caption: The exact learned curve for each top predictor, on the log-odds scale. Flat regions are values the model does not distinguish.

title: Decision-curve analysis
caption: Net benefit across plausible thresholds; the useful range is where the model sits above both default strategies.

title: Subgroup discrimination
caption: Several regional subgroups sit at or below chance; a national AUROC hides that. Subgroup n is small, so these are indicative.

title: Systematic candidate screening
caption: Every column of the Individual Recode screened on the development fold only; admission required the variable to be measured before or early in the pregnancy.

title: Preprocessing ablation
caption: The best variant buys +0.003 AP -- an order of magnitude less than the predictor set. Reported because a wins-only list would mislead.

title: Hyperparameter sensitivity
caption: Each bar moves one parameter away from the Optuna optimum with all others held; small bars mean the search bought little.

title: Tuning gain over library defaults
caption: Read against the ~0.08 development-to-held-out optimism gap: a tuning gain smaller than that is not evidence of better generalisation.

title: Performance across the ladder
caption: Development champion per rung, scored on held-out women. AP rises with prevalence and must never be compared across rungs; AUROC shows reaching care is easier to predict than completing it.

title: Importance shift across the ladder
caption: Green links: predictors that matter more as the threshold rises (engagement-limited); red: less (access-limited). Shares averaged over three independent importance methods.

title: Domain roll-up across the ladder
caption: Predictor importance aggregated into domains, normalised within rung, averaged over EBM, SHAP and drop-one.

title: Regional performance against circumstance
caption: Expected attainment predicted from wealth, education and household factors with region withheld; a positive gap means the region does better than its population profile implies.

title: Modifiable versus fixed decomposition
caption: Same folds, same model, three predictor subsets.

title: Near-threshold risk bands
caption: Women just below the operating threshold are the group a capacity-limited programme can realistically move.

title: Importance before and after grouping duplicates
caption: Travel time to hospital and residence are both present twice under different names, so per-column importance halves them.

title: 21-predictor set vs the full pool (85 distinct, 95 columns)
caption: Paired repeated splits; each dot is one split, the bar its mean. Logistic regression has almost nothing to tune, so it cannot favour a set through its hyperparameters.

caption: Every bar is one of the 67 pool candidates outside the 21; teal bars clear +0.005 AP on at least 4 of 5 splits. Dashed line is the threshold.

title: Tigray wartime difference-in-differences

title: Regional gap, all births vs recent births
caption: Expected attainment predicted with region withheld. The ranking is stable across the two windows, so it is not a period artefact.

title: Drop-one within the 21-predictor set
caption: Development AP lost when each member is removed from the 21 (fixed logistic regression at its own best regularisation, 5 split seeds). Grey = removing it costs nothing or helps. Ordered by ANC8+.

title: Value by set size, within the 21 and from the full pool
caption: Development AP above prevalence as a share of what the full pool reaches. The greedy path within the 21 peaks well before 21 and then falls; the sets chosen from the full pool reach further with fewer. Development folds, so the chosen sets are optimistic -- fig30 has the held-out view.

title: Predictor value across the ANC ladder
caption: Marginal value relative to the 21-predictor set (loss when dropped for members, marked [21]; gain when added for the rest), as a share of each rung's ceiling (full-pool AP minus prevalence). Sorted from most ANC1+-weighted to most ANC8+-weighted.

title: The two prediction horizons on the same women
